title: SARS-CoV-2 RNA Extraction with Ceres Nanotrap and Zymo Environ Water
author: Amanda Windsor

steps.title: Prepare Wastewater Sample
steps.instruction: Shake the wastewater bottle to mix and let it sit for 00:00:45.

steps.title: Transfer Wastewater to Tube
steps.instruction: Using a 10mL serological pipette, carefully pipette 10 mL of wastewater into a 15mL conical tube. (Note: Input volumes of 20, 30, and 40mL have also been tested).

steps.title: Add Enhancement Reagent
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of Nanotrap® Enhancement Reagent 2 (ER2) and invert the 15mL tube 2-3 times to mix.

steps.title: Add Nanotrap Particles
steps.instruction: Re-suspend Nanotrap® particles by inverting the bottle 5 times, then add particles to the sample based on the starting wastewater volume.

substeps.instruction: For 10 mL wastewater: Add 150 µL Nanotrap® particles
For 20 mL wastewater: Add 300 µL Nanotrap® particles
For 30 mL wastewater: Add 450 µL Nanotrap® particles
For 40 mL wastewater: Add 600 µL Nanotrap® particles

steps.title: Incubate Sample
steps.instruction: Incubate samples at room temperature for 00:10:00 with constant rotation.

steps.title: Separate Magnetic Particles
steps.instruction: Place samples on a magnetic rack for at least 00:02:00 to separate Magnetic Nanotrap® particles from the sample.

steps.title: Remove Supernatant
steps.instruction: After beads have settled, use a 5mL serological pipette to remove all of the supernatant without disturbing the pelleted beads.

steps.title: Wash Pelleted Beads
steps.instruction: Wash the beads using DNAse/RNAse Free water.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of DNAse/RNAse Free water to the tube.
Remove tube from magnet and re-suspend the pelleted beads using a 100-1000uL pipette.

steps.title: Transfer and Concentrate Beads
steps.instruction: Transfer the suspended beads to a 1.5mL microcentrifuge tube and place on a 2mL tube-compatible magnetic rack.

substeps.instruction: Incubate until the beads have settled (at least 00:02:00).
Remove supernatant with a 100-1000uL pipette without disturbing the pellet.
Remove any remaining supernatant with a smaller pipette tip (e.g., 2-20uL pipette).

steps.title: Elute from Beads
steps.instruction: Remove tubes from the magnet and re-suspend the pellet with 375 µL Zymo DNA/RNA Shield and 125 µL Zymo DNase/RNase-Free water from the Zymo Environ Water RNA Kit.

steps.title: Heat Treatment
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples at 95 °C for 00:05:00.

steps.title: Prepare Binding Tubes
steps.instruction: While samples are incubating, add 400 µL Zymo RNA Binding Buffer from the Zymo Environ Water RNA Kit to new 1.5mL tubes (one per sample).

steps.title: Collect Supernatant
steps.instruction: Remove tubes from heat block and place on a magnetic rack.

substeps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge to collect any liquid from caps prior to placing on the rack.
Allow beads to settle until supernatant is clear (at least 00:02:00).
Transfer 400 µL of supernatant to the corresponding tube prepared with Binding Buffer and mix by gentle pipetting (total sample volume = 800µL).

steps.title: First Column Purification
steps.instruction: Transfer the entire sample to a Zymo-Spin™ IIICG Column in a clean collection tube.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10000 x g, Room temperature, for 30 seconds.
Keep the flow-through (Label both the spin column and collection tube).

steps.title: Ethanol Wash and Second Column
steps.instruction: Perform ethanol wash and secondary column capture.

substeps.instruction: Add 800uL of ethanol (95-100%) to the flow-through from the previous step and mix well by gentle pipetting (total volume = 1600µL).
Transfer 800 µL into a new Zymo-Spin™ IIICG Column in a clean collection tube.
Centrifuge at 10000 x g, Room temperature, for 30 seconds and discard the flow through.
Repeat this process for the remaining 800 µL of sample using the same collection tube.

steps.title: Initial Elution
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL Zymo DNase/RNase-Free water directly to the column matrix and centrifuge at 10000 x g, Room temperature, for 30 seconds; keep the flow-through.

steps.title: Filter Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare a Zymo-Spin III-HRC Filter.

substeps.instruction: Place a Zymo-Spin III-HRC Filter into a new collection tube.
Add 600 µL Prep Solution.
Centrifuge at 8000 x g, Room temperature, for 3 minutes and discard the flow-through.
Transfer the column to an RNase-Free 1.5mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Filter RNA Concentration
steps.instruction: Transfer the eluted RNA from the previous step into the prepared Zymo-Spin III-HRC filter and centrifuge at 16000 x g, Room temperature, for 3 minutes; keep the flow-through.

steps.title: Final RNA Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the concentrated RNA using a Zymo-Spin IC column.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL RNA Binding Buffer to the filtrate and mix well by gently pipetting.
Add 300 µL of ethanol (95-100%) to the filtrate + RNA Binding Buffer and mix well by gently pipetting.
Transfer the mixture into a Zymo-Spin IC column in a collection tube and centrifuge at 10000 x g, Room temperature, for 30 seconds; discard the flow-through.
Add 400 µL of RNA Prep Buffer to the column and centrifuge at 10000 x g, Room temperature, for 30 seconds; discard the flow-through.
Add 700 µL of RNA Wash Buffer to the column and centrifuge at 10000 x g, Room temperature, for 30 seconds; discard the flow-through.
Add 400 µL of RNA Wash Buffer to the column and centrifuge at 10000 x g, Room temperature, for 2 minutes to ensure complete removal of the wash buffer.
Transfer the column carefully into an RNase-free tube.

steps.title: DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Perform on-column DNase digestion.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 µL RNA Wash Buffer to column and centrifuge at 10000 x g, Room temperature, for 30 seconds; discard flow-through.
Add 5 µL DNase I and 35 µL DNA Digestion Buffer to the column matrix.
Incubate at 27 °C for 00:20:00.

steps.title: Final Wash and Elution
steps.instruction: Finalize the RNA extraction.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 µL of RNA Prep Buffer to the column and centrifuge at 10000 x g, Room temperature, for 30 seconds; discard the flow-through.
Transfer column to an RNase-Free 1.5mL microcentrifuge tube.
Add 50 µL of DNase/RNase-Free Water directly to the column matrix and centrifuge at 10000 x g, Room temperature, for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Storage
steps.instruction: The eluted RNA can be used immediately or stored at -70 °C.

steps.title: Reagent Preparation (DNase I)
steps.instruction: Reconstitute and aliquot DNase I.

substeps.instruction: Add 275 µL DNase/RNase-Free water to reconstitute lyophilized DNase I (1U/µL).
Aliquot reconstituted DNase I in volumes appropriate for throughput (e.g., 15-20µL aliquots in 0.5mL microcentrifuge tubes) to avoid multiple freeze/thaw cycles.
